encoding.kanjiUnavailable: Manual Kanji mode is unavailable because the Shift JIS conversion helper did not load.

preview.encoderError: The first-party QR encoder did not load.

L.label: Low
L.detail: Uses the least redundancy and can still scan if about {recovery}% of the symbol area is damaged or covered.

M.label: Medium
M.detail: Balances capacity and resilience, with recovery for about {recovery}% of damaged or covered area.

Q.label: Quartile
Q.detail: Spends more of the code on correction data, allowing recovery from about {recovery}% damage or occlusion.

H.label: High
H.detail: Uses the most correction data, so the code can often survive about {recovery}% of its area being obscured.
